units.text: Ruling on one who forgets to recite Al-Fatihah
Also, if he forgets Al-Fatihah, should he perform another rak'ah to replace it? And should he prostrate for forgetfulness?

If he is a follower (ma'mum), there is nothing upon him. However, if he is an imam or praying alone, he should perform another rak'ah in place of the rak'ah in which Al-Fatihah was omitted. As for the follower, he follows his imam; if he forgets or misses standing (with the imam), it suffices him as long as he catches the prayer with the imam.
